project.name: SocialBoost AI — Signal Studio
project.description: Full-stack social video analysis studio: FastAPI + SQLite backend, Next.js frontend. Analysis, prediction, calendar and connected-account statistics all read from data uploaded or imported by the user; no placeholder metrics.

services.name: SocialBoost FastAPI backend
services.persistence: SQLite file created/upgraded automatically on startup by app/db/schema.py
services.notes: Start backend BEFORE the frontend: the frontend calls it at NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

services.name: SocialBoost Next.js frontend
services.notes: Next.js 16 has breaking changes vs older conventions; see frontend/AGENTS.md before writing frontend code.

envVariables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
envVariables.purpose: JSON list of allowed frontend origins

envVariables.name: MIN_TRAINING_ROWS
envVariables.purpose: Minimum history rows before a workspace model trains

envVariables.name: LIVE_PUBLISHING_ENABLED
envVariables.purpose: Live publishing is NOT implemented; keep false

envVariables.name: FRONTEND_URL
envVariables.purpose: Frontend base URL used by the backend

envVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
envVariables.purpose: Backend base URL consumed by the frontend

envVariables.name: IG_CLIENT_ID
envVariables.purpose: Optional Instagram OAuth (sandbox mode without it)

steps: Backend: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
Frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
localDevelopment.tests: cd backend && python -m pytest -q (runs against a temp database; does not touch dev data)

demoLogin.source: seed data in the development database

capabilities.auth: Email + password (bcrypt), JWT bearer tokens, per-user workspace
capabilities.upload: MP4/MOV/WebM/MKV, size-limited, metadata read with OpenCV
capabilities.analysis: Real frame measurements (brightness, contrast, scene changes, black frames), rule-based opening score with basis, technical checks, recommendations
capabilities.predictions: Random forest per workspace trained on imported history; ranges, confidence and feature importance come from that model
capabilities.datasets: CSV import with required-column validation, row rejection, duplicate post_id detection, template download
capabilities.calendar: Real month scheduling, update/cancel/delete, restart-safe jobs
capabilities.connectedAccounts: Sandbox connections store the handle and derive statistics from imported history
capabilities.analytics: Aggregates per workspace and platform (likes + comments + shares over views)
capabilities.drafts: Workspace-scoped caption/title drafts, optionally attached to a video

limitations: OAuth authorisation: start endpoint returns 400 and callback returns 501 without provider credentials; sandbox mode is used instead
Live publishing: not implemented — non-sandbox jobs are marked failed with an explanation, never published
Speech recognition: not installed; analysis reports speech_analysis as unavailable
OCR: only runs when Tesseract is installed, otherwise reported as unavailable
Audio detection: has_audio reported as false (ffprobe not part of this build)

machineLearning.artifacts: Model artifacts are stored per workspace under ml/artifacts/ and are git-ignored

structure.backend/: FastAPI app (app/api, app/core, app/db, app/integrations, app/models, app/schemas, app/services, app/workers) + tests
structure.frontend/: Next.js App Router (public marketing pages, /app dashboard, /login, /signup)
structure.ml/: Training, prediction and evaluation scripts and sample data
